title: Construction factorial screen - cell C3: multi-scale patches (3/5/7) vs a single 6x6 scale at matched per-image cost
question: Does a three-scale patch construction (3x3 + 5x5 + 7x7, one 2x2 pool per scale, concatenated) beat the single-scale 6x6 pool construction at matched per-image cost?

registration_notes.N103.1: Per scale s in {3,5,7}: ZCA whitener on that scale's patch pool (20k sample images, 400k patches, seed 11, contrast 10.0, zca 0.1 — the M117 recipe per scale); 8,192 candidate pool = the seeded [11,100] permutation of that scale's whitened pool; triangle code + one 2x2 sum pool (m107 edges rule round(grid_s*i/2)); scales concatenated.
registration_notes.N103.2: Matched-cost split (pool adds counted on every arm): atom budget = (pool2062 total 175,197,198 - per-scale whitening sum 19,673,784) split into EQUAL MAC shares per scale. Registered split: a3=1950, a5=850, a7=511 (total 3,311; width 13,244, Gram-feasible). MS total 175,153,892 vs pool 175,197,198 (delta 0.025%).
registration_notes.N103.3: Anchors: t1 in-run bitwise determinism of the multi-scale encode (no sealed multi-scale artifact exists; the cdist/activation/pool arithmetic is the sealed code per scale, and the edges rule is unit-tested); t2 environment anchor on the sealed f6144 codes (0.26136231884058 +-0.002); t4 the cached pool2062 codes refit must reproduce their sealed C2 read 0.227536231884058 +-0.002.
registration_notes.N103.4: Gate: Q_MS(409832) >= Q_pool(2062, 409832) + 0.005 at penalty 1.0, matched cost (|MS - pool| <= 0.5%). Ridge ladder {0.1, 1.0, 10.0}, per-scale diagnostics, and the trained-head read are reported; the cell closes as a scoped negative only if BOTH the gate fires AND the trained-head read fails. The power-norm composition (multi-scale + signed sqrt + L2) is a registered FOLLOW-UP free cell, not part of this gate.
registration_notes.N103.5: Smoke runs declare _smoke_note and MUST refuse the sealed output directory.

sparse.note: per-scale whiteners and dictionaries per the M117/M126 recipe; the pool arm is the CACHED C2 pool2062 artifact, never re-encoded.

matched_cost.split_rule: equal MAC share per scale after the per-scale whitening sum
matched_cost.note: Same ledger exclusions as the sealed ledger.

anchors.t4_note: the sealed C2 pool2062 full-data read at penalty 1.0

cell_c3.gate_registered: fired if Q_MS(409832) < Q_pool(2062, 409832) + 0.005 at penalty 1.0 (matched cost verified by the runner); the cell closes as a scoped negative only if the trained-head read also fails.
cell_c3.consequence_fired: multi-scale patches do not lift the single-scale construction at matched cost; C3 is a scoped negative at this cost point.
cell_c3.consequence_passed: multi-scale patches beat the single-scale construction at matched cost; C3 is promoted at this cost point and the power-norm composition follows as a free cell.
